description:
A unique 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse loft conversion residing atop an Edwardian Warehouse conversion in Hackney, E8.
 
Tucked away behind secure gates on the charming cobbled Brett Passage, this exceptional 3-bedroom penthouse forms part of an exclusive development of just 8 individually designed apartments in Hackney, E8.
 
Positioned above a converted warehouse, the penthouse offers a striking blend of contemporary architecture and industrial-inspired design. Flooded with natural light through dramatic angled glazing and multiple rooflights, the impressive open-plan living space features exposed brickwork, engineered timber flooring and a series of bespoke design details that give the apartment a character rarely found in modern developments.
 
 At the heart of the home is a beautifully crafted kitchen centred around a substantial granite island with integrated gas hob, complemented by stone worktops, integrated appliances and extensive storage.
 
The principal bedroom benefits from a stylish ensuite shower room with walk-in rainfall shower, while the main bathroom is finished with micro cement walls and flooring, incorporating a freestanding bath, a separate walk-in shower, and sculptural stone-effect wash basins. Two further double bedrooms, and utility room with excellent storage complete the accommodation.
 
A cast-iron staircase provides access to the roof, where there is the exciting prospect of potentially creating a private roof terrace, subject to the necessary planning permissions and consents, presenting an exciting opportunity for a purchaser to further enhance an already distinctive home. An added bonus is the rare opportunity to purchase a secure parking via separate negotiation with a guide price of £35,000. 
 
Brett Passage was once part of the historic Mermaid Pleasure Gardens and today provides a peaceful, gated setting moments from the energy of Mare Street. Hackney Central Station is just 2-minutes’ walk away, with Hackney Downs, London Fields and Broadway Market all within easy walking distance.
keyFeatures: Potential to add roof terrace STTP
Parking space for sale by separate negotiation
Immediate proximity to Hackney Central station
